decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a specialized, long-cycle niche where the firm's robust-lighting expertise applies, keeping it on the market costs little, and the option holds value as defense procurement grows.

The general interior luminaire went from a dedicated page to a mere mention, a sign of maturing rather than failure, so the cheap-to-hold G2 generation stays in the core portfolio while its demand becomes clearer.
The microprismatic pendant is promoted as a flagship latest release that fits the firm's ergonomic, efficient LED direction, so the option merits further commitment rather than abandonment.

The firm already dropped the sibling HMI searchlight, which suggests pruning in its marine line, but the surviving searchlight is likely the more modern variant and still has low holding cost, so it is kept while its uncertainty resolves.
